title: 6 Tools Red Teams Use to Break In
description:
These are the 6 free tools red teams use to break into a network, and how to defend against every one.

1. Gophish - phishing, but for training your staff: https://getgophish.com
2. Responder - poison the network and catch password hashes: https://github.com/lgandx/Responder
3. Mimikatz - dump credentials straight from memory: https://github.com/gentilkiwi/mimikatz
4. Rubeus - abuse Kerberos tickets: https://github.com/GhostPack/Rubeus
5. BloodHound - map the shortest path to Domain Admin: https://bloodhound.specterops.io
6. Sliver - a modern open-source C2 framework: https://github.com/BishopFox/sliver
7. Build your own - stop chaining tools, build the operator.

FREE web-book, Become the Cyber Security Expert the AI Era Demands:
https://app.stationx.net/book

Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/c/+StationxNet?sub_confirmation=1

Music: "Mathilda on Acid" by Abstract Audio (CC BY 3.0)
https://ccmixter.org/files/Citizen_X0/28882

#Shorts #redteam #pentesting #activedirectory #cybersecurity
